about.heading: About me
about.subtitle: Engineer, not just a coder
about.bio: I'm a software engineer with 3 years of experience, 2 of them commercial. I specialize in Vue.js on the frontend but work across the full stack — Node.js and NestJS on the backend, relational and non-relational databases, and increasingly Java and Spring Boot. I care about code quality: I build UI component libraries with Storybook, run code reviews, and push for good practices in every team I join.
about.current_focus: Java / Spring Boot and Docker — deepening backend skills while continuing to lead on the frontend with Vue.js
